# key: # Task editor control (Controls/TaskEditor*). Merged into Resources.resw by gen_resw.py.

zh-CN: 选择左侧的任务进行编辑
en-US: Select a task on the left to edit it

zh-CN: 冷却从任务执行完成后开始计时；优先级高的任务在同一轮中先判断；运行次数上限为 0 表示不限。
en-US: Cooldown starts when the task finishes; higher priority tasks are checked first within a round; a run limit of 0 means unlimited.

zh-CN: 每一轮先判断前置条件，满足后才会依次判断下面的规则。留空表示总是满足。
en-US: Checked first every round; the rules below are only considered when it holds. Empty means always.

zh-CN: 规则按顺序判断：条件满足时执行对应动作。勾选“匹配后停止”可跳过本轮剩余规则。
en-US: Rules are checked in order; when a rule's conditions hold its actions run. "Stop after match" skips the remaining rules this round.
Pick a point on the picture
Select an area on the picture

zh-CN: 最近一次图像匹配位置
使用本规则（或前置条件）中最近一次图像匹配的中心；没有匹配时退回到下面的坐标。
en-US: Uses the centre of the latest image match in this rule (or the precondition); falls back to the point below.
How the conditions in this group combine

zh-CN: 下列条件全部为真时成立
en-US: True when every item below is true

zh-CN: 下列条件任一为真时成立
en-US: True when at least one item below is true

zh-CN: 下列条件都为假时成立
en-US: True when no item below is true

zh-CN: 空组：“任一”模式下永远不成立
区域为空时搜索整个屏幕（较慢）。
en-US: An empty area searches the whole screen (slower).

zh-CN: 颜色按 #RRGGBB 输入；容差是每个通道允许的最大差值。可先在投屏页的取点模式中查看像素颜色。
en-US: Enter the colour as #RRGGBB; tolerance is the maximum difference per channel. The Mirror page's pick mode shows pixel colours.

zh-CN: 支持算术、比较、逻辑 (&& || !)、字符串和函数 rand/min/max/abs/round/len 等；内置变量如 $match.x、$elapsed。
en-US: Supports arithmetic, comparison, logic (&& || !), strings and functions such as rand/min/max/abs/round/len; built-ins like $match.x and $elapsed.

zh-CN: 在当前画面上执行一次判断，并在工作台显示结果
en-US: Evaluate once on the current picture and show the result on the workbench
Choose or capture a template first.

zh-CN: 当前无法测试（没有画面或正在进行其他操作）。
en-US: Cannot test right now (no picture, or another operation is in progress).

zh-CN: 第 {0} 个字符处的占位符 {{}} 为空。
第 {0} 个字符处的 {{ 没有闭合，将按原样输出（字面量花括号请写 {{{{ 和 }}}}）。
en-US: The {{ at character {0} is not closed and will be output as is (write {{{{ and }}}} for literal braces).

zh-CN: 请选择一个按键，或输入 0–1000 之间的键码。
en-US: Choose a key or enter a key code between 0 and 1000.

zh-CN: 未声明的变量（按 0 处理）：{0}
用 {表达式} 插入变量值，例如 {count + 1}；字面量花括号写 {{ 和 }}。
en-US: Insert values with {expression}, e.g. {count + 1}; write {{ and }} for literal braces.

zh-CN: 还没有规则。添加一条规则，设置条件和要执行的动作。
en-US: No rules yet. Add a rule with conditions and the actions to run.

zh-CN: 条件成立时执行下面的动作；留空表示总是执行。
en-US: The actions below run when this holds; empty means always.

zh-CN: 按权重随机执行一个分支
en-US: Run one branch chosen by weight

zh-CN: 本规则执行后，跳过本任务在这一轮剩余的规则
en-US: After this rule runs, skip the task's remaining rules this round

zh-CN: 每次触发时按权重随机选出一个分支执行。权重为 0 的分支不会被选中。
en-US: Each time the rule fires one branch is picked at random by weight. Branches with weight 0 are never picked.

zh-CN: 被选中的概率与权重成正比
en-US: The chance of being picked is proportional to the weight
Choose or type a key code

zh-CN: 可直接输入 Android 键码数字，例如 61 (Tab)。
en-US: You can type an Android key code, e.g. 61 (Tab).

zh-CN: 最长大于最短时，在两者之间随机等待；否则固定等待最短时长。
en-US: When the maximum is greater than the minimum a random wait in between is used; otherwise the minimum.

zh-CN: 方案内的录制，或相对方案文件的路径
en-US: Embedded recording, or a path relative to the scheme file

zh-CN: 下拉列表中是方案内嵌的录制；也可以输入相对于方案文件的 .czrec 路径。
en-US: The list shows recordings embedded in the scheme; you can also type a .czrec path relative to the scheme file.

zh-CN: 停用本任务（本次运行内）
